title: Ce que le service peut confirmer
summary: A patient prepares for an information appointment and keeps official process details separate from personal medical advice.

sentences.fr: Avant un rendez-vous d'information, Malik a préparé une liste de questions sur le fonctionnement du service.
sentences.en: Before an information appointment, Malik prepared a list of questions about how the service worked.

sentences.fr: Il voulait savoir quels documents seraient conservés dans son dossier et qui pourrait les consulter.
sentences.en: He wanted to know which documents would be kept in his file and who could consult them.

sentences.fr: L'employée a expliqué les règles de confidentialité du service et la façon de demander une copie de son dossier.
sentences.en: The employee explained the service's privacy rules and how to request a copy of his file.

sentences.fr: Quand Malik a demandé si un symptôme précis exigeait une consultation urgente, elle a refusé de poser un diagnostic.
sentences.en: When Malik asked whether a particular symptom required urgent care, she declined to make a diagnosis.

sentences.fr: Elle lui a conseillé de parler directement à un professionnel de la santé pour cette question personnelle.
sentences.en: She advised him to speak directly with a health professional about that personal question.

sentences.fr: Malik a noté le numéro du service et a demandé où trouver les renseignements généraux sur les prochaines étapes.
sentences.en: Malik noted the service number and asked where to find general information about the next steps.

sentences.fr: Il est reparti avec une réponse claire sur le dossier et une limite claire sur ce que l'employée pouvait confirmer.
sentences.en: He left with a clear answer about his file and a clear boundary around what the employee could confirm.
sentences.note: Administrative staff can explain a service process; personal medical questions belong with a qualified health professional.

options: The exact result of a future appointment
The service's privacy rules and how to request a file copy
quiz.explain: The third sentence lists the administrative information she explained.

quiz.prompt: Why did the employee not answer the symptom question?
options: The service had no privacy rules
Malik had not brought his phone number
It required a health professional's assessment
quiz.explain: She declined to diagnose and directed him to a health professional.

options: What the service could confirm and where its limits were
That he no longer needed information
That the employee had diagnosed him
quiz.explain: The last sentence states he understood both the answer and its limit.
